scenario: When a purchase order is marked Approved in the procurement tracker sheet, create a matching draft bill in QuickBooks with the same vendor, line items, and PO number, and post the QuickBooks bill ID back into the sheet row.
When a vendor onboarding form is completed in Airtable with W-9 and banking verified, create the vendor in Xero and a matching account record in Salesforce, using the payment terms from the form.
rule_hooks: required documents checklist, payment terms table

scenario: When a vendor emails a bank-detail change and the AP lead marks the Zendesk ticket as Verified by callback, update the vendor's remittance details in QuickBooks and log the change in the vendor master sheet.
Each morning, read stock levels from the inventory sheet and, for SKUs below their reorder point, create purchase request tasks in Asana assigned to the buyer for that product category.
Copy new Shopify orders tagged for the East warehouse into the warehouse pick-list Google Sheet, skipping orders already present by order number and flagging ones with backordered SKUs.
When the logistics sheet gets a tracking number and ship date for an order, update the matching HubSpot deal's shipping fields and move it to the Shipped stage.

Convert new facilities requests from the Freshdesk Facilities group into Trello cards on the correct building board, copying location, priority, and requester, and write the card link back to the ticket.

When a vendor agreement is completed in DocuSign, update the vendor master sheet with the effective date, renewal date, and contract value, and attach the signed PDF link to the vendor's Salesforce account.
rule_hooks: contract term lengths, renewal notice periods

scenario: For vendor contracts in the contracts sheet with renewal dates in the next 90 days, create or update Google Calendar reminders for the contract owner at the notice deadline, without duplicating existing events.
rule_hooks: notice period per contract, owner directory

scenario: When HR marks a new hire as Confirmed in the onboarding sheet, create a Jira IT ticket listing the laptop model and software bundle for their role, and add the start date to the IT team calendar.

When an employee's termination date is entered in the HR sheet, find their assigned assets in the IT asset register and create recovery tasks in Monday.com, updating each asset's status to Pending Return.
Sync newly received laptops from the receiving log sheet into the Freshservice asset inventory with serial number, model, and warranty end date, matching on serial to avoid duplicates.
rule_hooks: warranty term by manufacturer, serial dedupe

scenario: Compare the active user list exported to a sheet from the SSO admin against the software license tracker, mark licenses for departed users as Reclaimable, and update seat counts per app.

When a vendor invoice arrives in the AP Gmail inbox, find the matching PO in the procurement sheet and, if the amount is within tolerance, create the bill in Xero linked to the PO; otherwise flag the row as Mismatch.
When the warehouse logs a goods receipt in the receiving sheet, update the corresponding PO line's received quantity in the procurement tracker and set the PO status to Partially or Fully Received.
rule_hooks: PO line quantities, receipt status rules

scenario: When a supplier's updated price list sheet is shared, update unit costs for matching SKUs in the product catalog sheet and the QuickBooks item list, noting the effective date.

When a Google Calendar event books a large conference room with catering noted in the description, create a matching setup request in the facilities Asana project with headcount, time, and room layout.
rule_hooks: room capacity list, catering lead time

scenario: When a vendor sends a certificate of insurance by email, update the vendor compliance sheet with coverage amounts and expiry date, and set the vendor's status in Salesforce to Compliant or Non-compliant.
rule_hooks: minimum coverage requirements by vendor type

scenario: After a site safety inspection form is submitted in Typeform-backed sheet, create a Jira ticket for each failed checklist item, assigned to the site facilities manager with due dates by severity.
Sync the preventive maintenance schedule sheet for HVAC, elevators, and fire systems into the facilities Google Calendar, updating events when service dates change and removing cancelled ones.
When a project milestone is marked complete in Asana for a customer implementation, update the corresponding Salesforce opportunity's implementation stage and milestone date fields.
Mirror the status, assignee, and due date of Jira tickets labeled ops-initiative into the operations portfolio Google Sheet, adding new rows for new tickets and updating existing ones by ticket key.
When a Zendesk return request is approved and marked Received, increase the stock quantity for the returned SKU in the inventory sheet and create a credit memo in QuickBooks for the customer.
rule_hooks: return condition grading, restocking fee policy

scenario: Pull carrier freight quotes received by email for open shipment requests, record them in the shipment log sheet, and mark the lowest compliant quote as Selected on the request row.
rule_hooks: approved carrier list, transit time limits

scenario: When a travel booking confirmation for an approved trip arrives in the travel inbox, add the flight and hotel costs to the trip row in the travel tracker sheet and create a pending expense entry in Expensify-style ledger sheet under the cost center.
rule_hooks: travel policy limits, cost center codes

scenario: When the hiring plan sheet shows a new hire's start date and office, assign an open desk from the seating chart sheet in that office's preferred team zone and update the onboarding ticket with the desk number.
rule_hooks: seating zones by team, desk availability

scenario: At month end, compute each vendor's on-time delivery rate from the receiving log and write it into the vendor scorecard sheet and the vendor's HubSpot company record, setting a review flag below threshold.
After recurring vendor review Zoom meetings end, add the meeting date, attendees, and recording link to the matching vendor row in the vendor meetings log sheet, and update the next-review date.
When multiple Intercom conversations are tagged delivery-delay for the same region within a day, create or update a single incident in the ops Jira project and record the conversation IDs on it.
rule_hooks: incident threshold count, region tag mapping

scenario: Pull posted operations expenses by account from Xero and update the department budget-versus-actual sheet for the current month, flagging categories exceeding budget.
rule_hooks: chart of accounts mapping, variance threshold

scenario: When a permit renewal is approved by email from a city agency, update the permits sheet with the new expiry and permit number, and update the linked compliance task in Monday.com to Done.
Log office supply requests posted in the #office-supplies Slack channel into the supply order sheet with item, quantity, and requester, consolidating duplicates for the weekly order.
When a customer's billing address or tax ID is updated on the HubSpot company record, apply the same change to the matching customer in QuickBooks and the order management sheet.
rule_hooks: field ownership rules, system of record

scenario: When a field service work order is marked Completed in the service tracker sheet, create an invoice in QuickBooks with labor hours and parts used, using the customer's contract rate.
rule_hooks: contract rate card, billable parts list

scenario: Copy approved weekly timesheets for contractors from the timesheet sheet into the matching Jira project time logs and update the contractor spend column in the vendor budget sheet.
rule_hooks: contractor hourly rates, PO spend caps

scenario: When a new office lease or amendment is executed in DocuSign, update the real estate register sheet with rent, escalation schedule, and term dates, and create a QuickBooks recurring bill for the landlord.
When a vehicle's mileage in the fleet log sheet passes its next-service threshold, create a service appointment on the fleet calendar and a maintenance ticket in Freshdesk with the vehicle details.
rule_hooks: service mileage intervals per vehicle model

scenario: When the inventory sheet shows a new expected restock date for a backordered SKU, update the expected ship date on all affected open orders in the order sheet and on the related Zendesk tickets.
For the quarterly SOX access review, copy the approval status from each manager's completed Jira review ticket into the audit evidence sheet, and mark systems missing reviews as Outstanding.

When a company offsite vendor booking (venue, AV, catering) is confirmed by email, update the event planning sheet's vendor rows with confirmation number and deposit due date, and create the deposit bill in Xero.

When a purchase requisition is approved in the procurement tool, create a matching sourcing task in Asana with the requester, budget code and needed-by date, and update the requisition's status back in the request sheet.

New closed-won Salesforce opportunities with physical line items are copied into the production scheduling sheet as work orders, with quantities and promised ship dates carried over and the opportunity stamped with the work-order ID.
rule_hooks: product family to production line mapping

scenario: After a cycle count is logged in the warehouse Google Sheet, update on-hand quantities for the counted SKUs in the inventory system and flag variances above tolerance in Slack #inventory.
Payment terms and early-pay discounts edited in QuickBooks vendor records are synced into the AP payment calendar sheet so the scheduled pay dates for open bills are recalculated.

When a HubSpot deal reaches Closed Won, create a customer implementation row in the ops onboarding tracker with contract tier, go-live target and assigned coordinator, then write the tracker row link back to the deal.
Building access-card requests approved in the helpdesk are carried into the facilities security access register with door zones and expiry dates, and the ticket is updated with the badge number.
Ecommerce orders containing drop-ship SKUs are copied to each supplier's shared order sheet with ship-to details, and the order record is tagged with the supplier and submission date.
Weekly warehouse shift assignments entered in the staffing sheet are synced to employees' Google Calendars as shift events, updating or removing events when assignments change.
Approved change requests in Jira Service Management are pushed into the shared IT change calendar with the maintenance window, affected systems and owner, and the ops status page sheet is updated.
Freshdesk tickets tagged as warranty claims are logged as claim rows in the supplier warranty tracker with serial number, purchase date and fault, and the ticket gets the supplier claim reference.
Newly approved Xero bills for facilities vendors are copied into the facilities cost-center spend sheet by building and category, keeping bill numbers and amounts consistent when bills are edited.
When a vendor NDA is completed in DocuSign, mark the vendor's NDA status and date in the vendor master sheet and create the portal-access request ticket in the IT helpdesk.
Receiving entries with lot and expiry numbers from the inbound log are carried into the quality control register, creating inspection rows for lots from suppliers on probation.
rule_hooks: supplier quality status and inspection sampling

scenario: AV equipment checkouts recorded in the facilities Airtable are synced to the IT asset sheet's location and custodian fields, and returned items are reset to their home room.
Shipping address changes on Salesforce accounts are propagated to the open orders in the fulfillment system and the carrier address book sheet, skipping orders already picked.
When an equipment installation card moves to Done in Trello, create the corresponding installation line on the customer's QuickBooks invoice draft using the job's billable hours and parts.
Facility or system outage posts in Slack #ops-alerts are logged into the site uptime tracker with start time, site and affected service, and the row is closed when a resolution message is posted.

Carrier freight invoices received in the AP Gmail inbox are entered into the freight audit sheet and matched to the shipment log's quoted rate, updating the shipment row with billed amount and discrepancy.
rule_hooks: accessorial charge rules and rate tolerance

scenario: Stock transfers between the two warehouses logged in the transfer sheet are recorded as matching outbound and inbound inventory adjustments in both locations' inventory records.
Zendesk tickets requiring an onsite technician visit are scheduled onto the field technicians' Google Calendar with address and ticket link, and the ticket is updated with the booked slot.
Contractor jobs approved in the facilities tracker are synced to the reception visitor list with dates and site, only when the contractor's insurance certificate on file is current.
Capital expenditure requests approved in Monday.com are added to the annual capex budget sheet under the right department and quarter, and the request item gets the budget line ID.
Newly received equipment over the capitalization threshold in the asset register is added to the depreciation schedule in the accounting sheet with in-service date and useful life.

Safety data sheets emailed by suppliers for newly ordered chemicals are logged into the chemical inventory register with hazard class and storage location, updating the matching PO line's compliance flag.
Customs broker entry notices from Gmail are matched to import shipments in the shipment log, filling entry number, duties paid and clearance date, and posting duties to the landed-cost sheet.
Company phone assignments changed in the IT helpdesk are synced to the wireless carrier line roster sheet with employee, department and plan, so the monthly bill can be allocated.

Vendor SLA breaches logged in the ops incident tracker are carried into the vendor credits sheet with the contractual credit amount and a credit memo request is created against the vendor in QuickBooks.
Consumption of consignment inventory recorded in the warehouse sheet is synced to each supplier's monthly usage report sheet so they can invoice what was used.
Purchase orders tagged with a project code in the procurement sheet are added to that project's budget tracker in Smartsheet with committed amounts, updating when the PO is revised or cancelled.
rule_hooks: project code validity and budget caps

scenario: Forklift and safety training completions from the LMS export are synced into the site compliance roster with certification and expiry dates, and Slack DMs go to supervisors of anyone now cleared.
Inbound carrier delivery notifications in Gmail are logged into the mailroom tracker with recipient and tracking number, and recipients are notified in Slack; entries close when marked picked up.
When product list prices change in the master price sheet, update the matching line items on open (not yet accepted) HubSpot quotes and note the change on the deal.
rule_hooks: price protection for quotes within validity

scenario: Software renewal invoices arriving in the AP inbox are matched to the SaaS inventory sheet, updating renewal amount, seat count and next renewal date, and the app owner is assigned a review task in Asana.
Janitorial service completion logs from the facilities form sheet are summarized per site and copied into the cleaning vendor's monthly reconciliation sheet, ready to compare against their invoice.
Salesforce cases approved for return are created as RMA entries in the returns authorization sheet with RMA number, SKU and reason, and the RMA number is written back to the case.
Manager and department changes in the HRIS export are carried into the procurement approval matrix sheet so each cost center's approvers stay current, with removed approvers flagged in Slack.
Parking permit requests approved in the facilities helpdesk are recorded in the parking register with plate, lot and permit expiry, and the ticket is updated with the assigned spot.
rule_hooks: lot allocation by role and capacity

scenario: W-9 forms received in the vendor docs inbox are used to update the vendor's tax ID, legal name and 1099 eligibility in QuickBooks and the vendor master sheet.

Temporary labor requests approved in the ops Slack workflow are copied to the staffing agency's shared order sheet with role, site, dates and bill rate, and the request is updated with the agency confirmation.
Monthly utility bills received by email are entered into the utilities tracker per building with meter reading and cost, and the building's sustainability sheet is updated with kWh and usage change.
